Swagger.Intro: Browse and try every Reporting API method of this Matomo. The specification is generated from the activated plugins.
Swagger.UseSession: Send requests with my current Matomo session
Swagger.UseSessionHelp: Try API methods without pasting a token. To test with a specific API token, disable this option and use the Authorize button.

OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanTitle: Events need to be set up manually
OpenmostCommunication.TrackingPlanBody: Events measure clicks, downloads, form submissions or video plays, once they are tracked. As an official Matomo Implementation Partner, Openmost designs and implements a tracking plan that fits your site.
OpenmostCommunication.EventsEnhancedLink: Get more out of your events with Events Enhanced
OpenmostCommunication.EcommerceEnhancedBody: Ecommerce Enhanced greatly extends Matomo's ecommerce features with new reports on products, brands, promotions, coupons, checkout funnels and buyers. It fits easily into your online store, with no specific development. Free plugin by Openmost.
